ctx.x: Biriato - B-i-R-i-a-t-o, Biriato. He was an architect, and he was very rich because he was in sympathy with Machado and he build, he made a replica of the castle, the Morro Castle of Havana with all the entrances and everything. It was just like Havana Bay in Marianao.
Okay, where was this beach at? This restaurant? Where? What part of Cuba?
